correctness.rationale: The finite construction takes exactly the first two 30-facet families in the explicit Balagopalan 32-vertex antipodal S⁴ definition, in two C₂×S₆-related orbits. Independently reconstruct all four facet families and verify their counts (30,30,120,120), full complex f=(32,240,660,750,300), and small 60-facet closure f=(32,210,480,270,60). A separate exact GF(2) chain-rank calculation directly on the full small complex yields ranks ∂1=31,∂2=179,∂3=210,∂4=60; hence unreduced β=(1,0,91,0,0) and reduced H₂ of rank 91. The packaged deterministic 270-collapse route agrees but is not needed to trust raw boundary ranks. This proves only mod-two homology, not a homotopy wedge or integral torsion claim.

value.rationale: Balagopalan's minimal antipodal S⁴ triangulation has a distinguished 60-facet symmetry orbit arising canonically from the construction. Its orbit-generated subcomplex is a mathematically motivated invariant; f-vector and unexpected 91 mod-two H₂ generators give precise new structural information useful for comparing symmetry-stratified triangulations. Does not require resolving integral homotopy or a full census.

scientific_limitations: Homology is only over F₂. No integral H₂ torsion, π1, wedge decomposition, or equivariant homotopy type established.
Prior ambient 32-vertex sphere and orbit sizes are credited, not claimed new.
